items.text: Among critical values verified by the network laboratory in 2024 and 2025, what proportion were notified with documented read-back within 30 minutes of verification, and how did this differ by patient location, time of day, analyte, night staffing and number of call attempts?
items.population: Critical values verified by the core laboratory, January 2024 to December 2025
items.intervention: Patient location, time of verification, analyte group, night staffing and call attempts (exposures)
items.comparator: Inpatient results verified in working hours
items.outcome: Documented read-back within 30 minutes of verification
items.setting: Three hospitals and 40 community clinics served by one core laboratory

finer: Feasible from an approved extract in 60 hours; interesting to the laboratory director and clinics; novel for this network; ethical with the approved waiver; relevant to an escalation decision in 2027.
summary: One PECO question with location and time as the main exposures.
